instruction: Candid cinematic film still, medium shot. Inside a dim underground parking garage, the woman in the black bucket hat (R2) stands in the center, carrying the smiling woman in the black beanie (R1) on her hip. On the right, the woman in the olive vest (R3) leans in from the side, wrapping her arm around the neck of the woman in the black bucket hat (R2). They are all laughing in a playful group embrace. Cool overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the trio against the dark, concrete background.
